scope: Twelve authored synthetic transfer diagnostics across four new obligation families. Authored after the v4 prompt was fixed; same engineering author, not a blinded independent holdout or representative production sample. Labels test complete support, explicit incompatible facts and missing guarantees or conditions. Never used as prompt examples.
